Sanjay / Hannah — quick technical update. We confirmed the spike and captured a sample trace. Key findings:
- The error pattern is concentrated on requests with token windows under 32 tokens where a newer kernel variant attempts a vectorized attention path that hits a mem-bound assertion on certain GPU driver revisions.
- This triggers an exception surfaced as 5xx from the runtime rather than graceful degradation.

Mitigation steps taken (in order):
1) Traffic reroute to rayleigh-stable-202805 for RetailCorp (policy override) — in progress and showing rollback in 2min for sampled flows.
2) Deploy a temporary kernel fallback flag to the affected fleet (ops_mitigation_patch.diff attached).
3) Rebuild the kernel with guard checks and stage to canary; if green, we will roll to the rest of US fleet.

Estimated timeline: reroute -> immediate; kernel fallback -> 20–30m to propagate; full patch -> 2–4 hours depending on canary results.

Action items for RetailCorp: no change required on your end while we route traffic. If you need all traffic pinned to rayleigh-stable-202805, let me know and we can apply that for the next 24h.
